best=[]
for w in np.linspace(0.05,6,600):
    B=np.column_stack([np.ones_like(t),np.sin(w*t),np.cos(w*t)])
    cc,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(B,r0,rcond=None)
    rr=r0-B@cc
    best.append((1-np.var(rr)/np.var(r0),w))

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):

import numpy as np
edges=np.quantile(t,np.linspace(0,1,16))
tb=np.clip(np.searchsorted(edges,t,side='right')-1,0,14)
I=np.eye(15)[tb]
def test(fs,name):
    X=np.column_stack([I[:,k]*f for k in range(15) for f in fs])
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    print(name, np.mean((X@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt))
one=np.ones_like(P)
test([one,P],'lin')
test([one,P,P**2],'quad')
test([one,P,P**2,P**3],'cubic')
test([one,P,np.sqrt(P)],'sqrt')
test([one,P,np.log(P)],'log')
test([one,P,P**2,np.log(P)],'quad+log')
test([one,P,1/P],'inv')
test([one,P,np.exp(-P)],'expP')
test([one,P,P/(1+P)],'sat')

import numpy as np
def run(nb):
    edges=np.quantile(t,np.linspace(0,1,nb+1))
    tb=np.clip(np.searchsorted(edges,t,side='right')-1,0,nb-1)
    I=np.eye(nb)[tb]
    def test(fs,name):
        X=np.column_stack([I[:,k]*f for k in range(nb) for f in fs])
        c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)
        print(nb,name, round(np.mean((X@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt),7))
    one=np.ones_like(P); L=np.log(P)
    test([one,P,P**2,L],'quad+log')
    test([one,P,L],'lin+log')
    test([one,P,P*L],'lin+PlogP')
    test([one,P,P**2,P*L],'quad+PlogP')
    test([one,P,P**2,L,P*L],'quad+log+PlogP')
run(15); run(25)
